title: Supply Chain Attack on org.mvnpm:posthog-node
technical_mechanism: same setup_bun.js payload as npm wave; auto-mirrored from compromised npm package
summary: A malicious package 'org.mvnpm:posthog-node' was discovered in the Maven ecosystem. The attack involved cross-registry worm propagation. Mechanism: same setup_bun.js payload as npm wave; auto-mirrored from compromised npm package
